_doc: ReShade shader packs offered in ReShade > Shaders. 'source' is a GitHub repository's latest release (with the asset's extension) or a download address. 'default' and Essential packs are selected until the user chooses; 'requires' packs come along. The first pack to supply a file wins, in this order. Pack list after RHI (github.com/RankFTW/RHI).
